title: Q3 Experimental Endpoints: Dark-Launch & Rollback Framework for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Priya Nair
description: We need a repeatable, low-friction framework to dark-launch experimental model variants and new hosted endpoints (feature flags + traffic mirroring) while guaranteeing rapid rollback when regressions appear. This ticket defines the product requirements, success metrics, and cross-functional tasks for a Q3 initiative enabling staged experiments against the Hosted API + Model Catalog. The goal is to lower time-to-evaluate new model variants in production-like conditions without exposing customers to instability.
acceptance_criteria: Product UX: Admins can configure an experimental endpoint in Console with: target model variant, traffic mirror % (0-100), canary window, and auto-rollback thresholds
Routing: Platform routes mirrored traffic for evaluation and can route a configurable small percentage of live traffic for gradual ramp-ups
Observability: Dashboards show per-variant latency, token cost, error rate, and quality regressions vs baseline using eval prompt sets
Rollback: Automatic rollback triggers and manual rollback flows available; rollback completes within 30s for config changes and within 5 minutes for model swaps
Safety: No customer PII is persisted to analytics buckets during mirrored experiments unless opt-in is enabled and audited
Docs: Runbook and Console docs published with step-by-step dark-launch checklist and ownership matrix
success_metrics: Time from model variant upload to first production-shaped evaluation < 72 hours
> 50% of internal model experiments run through dark-launch framework by end of quarter
Average rollback time under 5 minutes for manual triggers during canary
Measured model quality delta (nLG-based eval) captured for 100% of mirrored traffic experiments

tasks: Define experiment schema in model catalog (owner: ENG) - includes variant metadata, eval prompts, sensitivity tags
Console UX: Add 'Experiment' create flow and status page (owner: DES)
Runtime: Implement traffic mirroring and safe ramp controls; expose API to configure mirror % (owner: ENG)
Observability: Add variant-level dashboards and automated quality regressions alerts tied to eval prompt sets (owner: DATA/ENG)
Safety & Privacy: Ensure PII redaction or opt-in audit trail for mirrored requests (owner: Security)
Rollout policy: Implement auto-rollback rules (latency/error/quality) and manual rollback API (owner: ENG)
Runbook: Write step-by-step dark-launch checklist and incident playbook (owner: PM)
Pilot coordination: Identify internal customers and experiments for pilot (owner: PM)
Docs: Console help, API docs, and sample scripts for experiment evaluation (owner: DX)
Legal sign-off: Confirm data handling for mirrored traffic with Privacy & Legal (owner: Legal)
Cost assessment: Estimate incremental hosting costs for mirrored traffic and dashboards (owner: Finance)
Release gating: Define criteria for GA and for restricting to Dedicated/Private tenants (owner: PM)
decisions: Start with mirror-only experiments (no initial customer-facing traffic split) for first 2 sprints to validate observability
Persist only aggregated metrics by default; raw mirrored request retention requires explicit opt-in and auditing
Auto-rollback thresholds will be conservative by default (tight latency/error bands) but adjustable per-experiment
Model catalog will store a lightweight experiment manifest linking variant -> eval prompt set -> owner
Initial pilot limited to Hosted API; Dedicated capacity/Private rollout deferred until Q4 after auditing
open_questions: What is the minimal eval prompt set required to catch quality regressions for chat-style workloads?
How much mirrored traffic is needed for statistically significant quality signals across long-tail prompts?
Can we implement KV-cache-safe mirroring without exposing internal cache artifacts?
Will customers want the ability to opt-in to mirrored experiments for their traffic? If so, what consent flow is required?
How to represent cost attribution for mirrored traffic on tenant bills during piloting?
